instrument: Biacore-style optical biosensor; Fc1 and Fc2 in series (Fc1 upstream)

surfaces.1: anti-His capture antibody, no antigen captured (reference)
surfaces.2: anti-His capture antibody; His-tagged antigen captured at the start of every cycle

antibodies.note: antigen density is low enough that each IgG binds one antigen

tandem.note: the second injection follows the first without a wash; 'buffer' means running buffer was injected in that slot

regeneration: both flow cells regenerated to the bare capture antibody after every cycle
